axis_key: AxisVector on a 0-10 scale: structure, competitive, public, group_size, career, physical, creative, cause, novelty, identity.
note: Org names and categories sourced from Penn's own student club directory, pasted in full and parsed programmatically (categories were concatenated without separators in the source and reconstructed via a vocabulary-based tokenizer). The directory's own category tags were mapped to this app's 14-category taxonomy using a priority-ordered mapping (see scripts/build_penn_seed.py); axis tags were generated the same way as Columbia, NYU, and Cornell -- category-level default vectors plus light keyword nudges based on each org's name. Also includes Penn's 37 recognized Greek chapters and its student government structure, both sourced separately since they sit outside the main club directory. Treat these as a reasonable v1, not precise per-org judgments; refine by hand for any org that ends up in your top demo matches.
